title: Conditional finite-mixture sign-change diagnostic
purpose: Record an exact finite diagnostic for a future PAH-OMC-014 component mismatch. If a normalized nonnegative mixture has zero scalar mismatch for one fixed common cylinder, at least one component mismatch is nonpositive and at least one is nonnegative. This narrows the source-owner task without supplying sector weights or asserting that cancellation is attainable.

lean.scope: Abstract finite nonempty index type, normalized nonnegative real weights and an exact zero scalar weighted mismatch; no PAH component vector or source law is instantiated.

fixed_scope.functional_and_states: Use unchanged PAH-001 fixed-Q functional/rates and PAH-OMC-014 fixed-Q Gibbs components; no counterterm, refit, conditional averaging, new carrier or altered projection.
fixed_scope.mismatch_definition: For one fixed bounded grade-blind common cylinder f and a future source-owned finite component block, d(i) is the exact scalar projective mismatch of component i. R505 uses only the supplied real values.
fixed_scope.mixture_definition: weightedMismatch(w,d)=sum_i w_i*d(i) over a finite nonempty component index type.
fixed_scope.hypothesis: Weights are nonnegative, normalized, and the weighted mismatch is exactly zero.
fixed_scope.conclusion: The component mismatch range crosses zero weakly: some d(i)<=0 and some d(j)>=0.
fixed_scope.boundary: Retain the R-484 hidden-diagonal defect 16/9 in any future d(i); retain R-490 C_sw=540 as domination-only. Neither is a sector probability or a separator.

assumptions: The component index type is finite and nonempty.
Every mixture weight is nonnegative and the weights sum to one.
The exact scalar weighted mismatch is zero.
theorem_contract.conclusion: At least one component mismatch is <=0 and at least one is >=0.
not_supplied: No converse construction of weights is asserted.
No PAH component mismatch vector or source-owned full-Q law is supplied.
No claim that zero lies in the convex hull for the actual PAH components is made.
No projective kernel, common embedding, tail estimate, Cauchy error, weak limit or stationarity passage is established.

source_owner_obligation: Supply the exact d(i) vector for one fixed common cylinder and finite component block.
If exact projectivity is claimed, supply normalized nonnegative weights or a cross-Q stochastic kernel independently of the observed mismatch.
If exact projectivity is denied, prove a source-owned one-sided separator or a convex-hull no-zero certificate; R505 shows that any exact zero mixture would require weak sign crossing.
Retain the fixed PAH-001 limit order, R-484 boundary defect and R-490 domination role.
non_claims: This theorem does not instantiate PAH sector weights, a projective kernel, or a full-Q Gibbs state.
It does not prove that cancellation exists when signs cross, and it does not upgrade the Q=0 route-local obstruction to a global no-go.
It does not prove a weak cylinder limit, positivity/normalization of omega, R-488 global nonzero, stationarity, closability or a semigroup.
No physical Pre-A, spacetime, QFT, gravity, Yang--Mills, mass-gap or TOE conclusion follows.
Markov time remains external stochastic time.

next_question: For one source-owned PAH-OMC-014 cylinder, does the exact finite component mismatch vector admit a common one-sided separator, or does its convex hull contain zero under an independently supplied normalized law?
revisit_condition: Reopen when the source owner supplies the exact mismatch vector and normalized law/kernel, or a no-zero convex-hull certificate, without fitting to the target cylinder.
